title: Microsoft Dataverse: bulk delete gains run details and solution-aware jobs
summary: The roadmap facts, governance paths and automation calls are supported, including the warning that imported deletion jobs run immediately. One descriptive comparison should be narrowed: Microsoft documents bulk deletion at scale but does not establish that it is one of only a few Dataverse tools that can do this.

claims.claim: BulkDeleteFailure stores failures for records not deleted and exposes information about the error.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Bulk delete jobs are solution-aware and can be added to solutions to move between environments.
claims.quote: Bulk delete jobs are solution-aware, so you can add them to a solution to make them portable across environments.

claims.claim: One or more bulk deletion jobs can be added as Data Life Cycle Config components.
claims.quote:
Select Add existing > More > Other > Data Life Cycle Config.
Select one or more bulk deletion jobs to add to the solution.

claims.claim: Exporting and importing these solutions works the same as for other solution components.
claims.quote: Exporting and importing solutions containing bulk deletion jobs works the same as with other solution components.

claims.quote: Only admins can create and import solutions containing bulk deletion jobs.

claims.claim: Only bulk deletion jobs created in Power Platform environments can be solution-aware.
claims.quote: Only bulk deletion jobs created in Power Platform environments can be solution-aware.

claims.claim: Only job definitions are portable through solutions.
claims.quote: Only job definitions are portable.

claims.claim: Deleted data is not included in the portable solution.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; controls[2].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Imported bulk deletion jobs run immediately on import rather than requiring a separate start step.
claims.quote: Imported bulk deletion jobs run immediately on import. Plan imports carefully.

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[1].note; Governance guidance
claims.claim: If a bulk delete job fails or ends prematurely, records already deleted are not rolled back.
claims.quote: If a bulk delete job fails or ends prematurely, the operation doesn't roll back any deleted records. The record data remains deleted.

claims.claim: Bulk delete is one of the few Dataverse tools that removes records at scale.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse bulk deletion tools "one of" "few"; opened https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/delete-data-bulk and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/delete-bulk-records. Neither establishes the comparison with other tools.
claims.fix: Replace 'Bulk delete is one of the few Dataverse tools that removes records at scale' with 'Bulk delete removes Dataverse records at scale'.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated how these changes affect existing unpackaged bulk delete jobs.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse "solution-aware" "bulk" "existing" jobs; opened https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/delete-bulk-records and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/delete-data-bulk. Neither describes a migration or change to unpackaged jobs.

claims.claim: The wizard's Permanent deletion checkbox permanently removes records so they cannot be recovered.
claims.quote: The Bulk Deletion Wizard includes a Permanent deletion checkbox. When selected, records deleted by the bulk delete job are permanently removed and can't be recovered.

claims.claim: Permanent deletion skips moving a job's deleted records to deleted records tables when deleted record keeping is enabled.
claims.quote: If deleted record keeping is turned on for your environment, this option skips the step of moving data to deleted records tables, which results in faster job execution.

claims.claim: The solution-aware bulk deletion notes do not identify a specific role or security privilege beyond admins.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse "Data Life Cycle Config" "role" import; Dataverse solution aware bulk deletion jobs Run details licensing license meter prerequisites existing jobs admins role. Opened https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/delete-bulk-records; notes specify only admins.

claims.claim: Running a bulk delete job through the API requires BulkDelete privileges on the table types being deleted.
claims.quote: To run a bulk delete job, you must have BulkDelete and Delete privileges on the table types you're deleting.

claims.claim: Running a bulk delete job through the API also requires Delete privileges on those table types.
claims.quote: To run a bulk delete job, you must have BulkDelete and Delete privileges on the table types you're deleting.

claims.claim: Running the job requires read permission on the records specified by QuerySet.
claims.quote: You must also have read permissions on the table records that you specify in the QuerySet property.

claims.claim: A system administrator has the API permissions needed for bulk deletion by default.
claims.quote: A system administrator has the necessary permissions by default. Grant them to other users.

claims.claim: Bulk deletion supports recurring, periodic deletion jobs.
claims.quote:
Delete data periodically.
Schedule the start time of a recurring bulk delete.

claims.claim: Bulk deletion can trigger a table's delete plug-in or workflow for each deleted record.
claims.quote: If the delete action on a specific table type triggers a plug-in or a workflow (process), the bulk delete job triggers the plug-in or workflow every time it deletes a table record of that type.

claims.claim: The roadmap and bulk deletion documentation describe no agent or AI action for these changes.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse bulk deletion Run details solution aware jobs AI agent action; opened https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/delete-bulk-records and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/delete-data-bulk; read roadmap record. No AI or agent action is described.

claims.claim: Bulk deletion settings are at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Data management > Bulk deletion.
claims.quote:
In the navigation pane, select Manage, then in the Manage pane, select Environments.
On the Environments page, select an environment.
In the command bar, select Settings.
Expand Data management, then select Bulk deletion.
